info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Tracks-v2-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Tracking API provides a comprehensive overview of the tracking information for logistics shipments. Users can retrieve detailed status updates, location data, and estimated delivery times for their shipments. This API is designed for logistics managers, supply chain professionals, and businesses tracking their delivery processes. It supports efficient tracking of shipments, ensuring that users can manage their logistics operations effectively.

get.summary: Track the status of a shipment.
get.description: Retrieve the current status and details of a shipment using its tracking number. This endpoint allows you to monitor your shipment's journey and provides updates on its estimated delivery time.

requestBody.description: Request body for tracking shipments. This should include necessary parameters to identify the shipment for tracking purposes.

200.description: The shipment tracking information retrieved successfully.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for tracking shipments operations in a GET request.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksResponse_200.title: Shipment Tracking Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the shipment tracking request.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the tracking operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the tracking request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message related to the shipment tracking status.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response for the shipment tracking operation.
